decks.name: LeetCode #100 - Same Tree
decks.description: Check if two binary trees are structurally identical with same node values

cards.question: Same Tree: Given the roots of two binary trees p and q, write a function to check if they are the same or not. Two binary trees are considered the same if they are structurally identical, and the nodes have the same value.

solutions.name: Depth First Search
solutions.explanation: Use recursive DFS to compare trees node by node. Base case returns true if both nodes are null. Check if both nodes exist and have equal values, then recursively compare left and right subtrees. Returns false if structure differs or values mismatch. Clean recursive solution with O(h) space for call stack.

semanticLines: Define function isSameTree that accepts p and q as optional TreeNode and returns boolean.
Check if p does not exist and q does not exist using not operator.
If both null, return True as same empty trees.
Check if p exists and q exists and p dot val equals q dot val.
If both exist with same value, return result of isSameTree with p dot left and q dot left and isSameTree with p dot right and q dot right using and operator.
If not matching, return False.
codeLines: def isSameTree(p: Optional[TreeNode], q: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
if not p and not q:
if p and q and p.val == q.val:
return isSameTree(p.left, q.left) and isSameTree(p.right, q.right)

solutions.spaceDescription: Recursion stack space proportional to tree height h, O(log n) for balanced tree, O(n) worst case for skewed tree
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given p=[1,2,3] and q=[1,2,3]: isSameTree(1,1): values equal. Check left: isSameTree(2,2): values equal, both leaves return true. Check right: isSameTree(3,3): values equal, both leaves return true. All match, return true.

solutions.name: Iterative DFS
solutions.explanation: Use stack to perform iterative DFS comparing node pairs. Initialize stack with root pair. Pop pairs, check if both null (continue), if one null or values differ (return false), otherwise push left and right child pairs to stack. Process until stack empty. Avoids recursion with explicit stack.

solutions.name: Breadth First Search
solutions.explanation: Use two queues for level-order traversal of both trees simultaneously. Process nodes level by level, checking if corresponding nodes match. If both null continue, if one null or values differ return false, otherwise add children to respective queues. Complete traversal confirms trees are identical.
